jobs.description: About us:Welcome to Crowne Plaza Amsterdam – South, a modern business hotel in the lively Zuidas district. With 207 rooms, 7 meeting venues, and buzzing spots like De Japanner Zuid and the Manhattan Lounge-Bar, we offer guests and team members a place to connect, grow, and belong — as part of the global IHG Hotels & Resorts family.Your day to day:As an Fulltime F&B Allround Waiter at Japanner Restaurant, you'll bring warmth, professionalism, and personality to every guest experience. Repair & Overhaul Technician | Eindhoven Region Repair and overhaul Parts and machines with overhaul or repair work Working hours Language Dutch or English What will you be doing? This is repair and overhaul work. Parts and machines come in to you and go back out to specification, with the technical drawing as your reference. You disassemble them, assess what's worn or damaged, replace what needs replacing, and rebuild the whole as specified by the drawing. Overhaul work calls for a different kind of craftsmanship than building something new. You don't know in advance what you'll find, so your judgement determines what's needed. Anyone already doing this work in high-tech metalworking knows the difference. Repairing parts and machines according to technical drawings; Disassembling and assessing incoming parts; Carrying out overhaul work and replacing worn or damaged parts; Rebuilding and checking that everything is back to specification; Recording your findings and the work carried out. What do we offer? Gross monthly salary between €2,700 and €3,200 Room to grow in your trade Appreciation for your dedication, character, and craftsmanship An environment where collaboration, respect, and a down-to-earth attitude come first What you bring You've got overhaul and repair work in your hands: you can see what's happened to a part and know what it takes to bring it back to specification. You read a drawing without hesitation. Experience with overhaul or repair work; Reading technical drawings; Dutch or English. About the company You'll work at a company in high-tech metalworking that supplies solutions to clients in the Netherlands and abroad. Collaboration, respect, and a down-to-earth attitude are central, and you'll have the room to be yourself and show what you're good at.
